paragraphs: I have worked in marketing automation with Salesforce Marketing Cloud since 2017, delivering significant projects for BMO Financial Group, FreshBooks and Purolator.

I build clean, semantic emails and landing pages in HTML, CSS and AMPscript, write SQL to segment and personalize audiences, and set up automated nurture campaigns in Journey Builder and Automation Studio.
Outside of work, you'll find me on the tennis court or catching a new sci-fi flick.
